Article Title: Revealed: The unique record of Slavko Vinčić, Argentina vs Spain World Cup final referee, with Messi and Yamal’s sides
Article Text:
Slavko Vinčić to referee Messi’s Argentina vs Yamal’s Spain in 2026 World Cup final showdown/ AI Image

From Slovenia to football's biggest stage

World Cup journey reaches its pinnacle





Referee Slavko Vincic, of Slovenia, talks to Ecuador's Piero Hincapie (3) during the World Cup round of 32 soccer match between Mexico and Ecuador in Mexico City, Tuesday, June 30, 2026. (AP Photo/Fernando Llano)

His record with Argentina





Spain's unbeaten record under Vinčić





Before Lamine Yamal's emergence





During the Yamal era





Career continued after 2020 police investigation

FIFA has entrusted Slovenian referee Slavko Vinčić with the biggest appointment of his career, confirming that he will officiate Sunday's 2026 FIFA World Cup final between defending champions Argentina and Spain at New York New Jersey Stadium.The 46-year-old has spent nearly two decades climbing through European football's refereeing ranks and now becomes the man tasked with overseeing one of the most anticipated World Cup finals in recent history. He will be assisted by fellow Slovenians Tomaž Klančnik and Andraž Kovačič, while Jordan's Adham Makhadmeh has been appointed fourth official and Mohammad Alkalaf reserve assistant referee.For Vinčić, the appointment represents the culmination of a career built on steady progression through domestic, European and international football.Born in Maribor, Slovenia, in 1979, Vinčić began refereeing professionally in his home country's top division in 2007 before earning his FIFA international badge in 2010.His performances quickly established him among UEFA's elite officials, leading to regular appointments in the Champions League and Europa League.Over the past decade, he has officiated some of European football's biggest occasions, including the 2022 UEFA Europa League final between Eintracht Frankfurt and Rangers and the 2024 UEFA Champions League final between Real Madrid and Borussia Dortmund.Alongside his club assignments, Vinčić has become a regular at international tournaments, officiating at UEFA Euro 2020, Euro 2024, the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar and now the 2026 World Cup, where his performances have earned him the tournament's showpiece fixture.According to Transfermarkt , Vinčić has officiated more than 500 senior professional matches, issuing 2,093 yellow cards, 113 red cards and awarding 117 penalties during his career.Sunday's final will be Vinčić's eighth World Cup match across the last two tournaments.He first appeared at the World Cup in Qatar in 2022 before returning for four further appointments during the 2026 tournament. Those performances convinced FIFA's refereeing department to hand him the final between Spain and Argentina.Earlier in this World Cup, Vinčić officiated Brazil's group-stage draw with Morocco, Algeria's victory over Jordan and Mexico's Round of 32 win against Ecuador.That knockout fixture attracted particular attention after Vinčić dismissed Ecuador defender Piero Hincapié following a VAR review for covering his mouth while speaking to Mexico striker Santiago Giménez, marking the first red card of his major international tournament career after previously overseeing ten World Cup and European Championship matches without sending off a player.Despite Argentina's regular appearances at major tournaments, Vinčić has refereed Lionel Scaloni's side only once before.That solitary meeting came in one of the most memorable matches of the 2022 World Cup, Argentina's shock 2-1 defeat to Saudi Arabia in their opening group-stage fixture.The Slovenian official awarded Argentina an early penalty after Leandro Paredes was fouled inside the area, allowing Lionel Messi to score from the spot, and later showed six yellow cards to Saudi Arabia players.Although Argentina suffered one of the greatest upsets in World Cup history that afternoon, they recovered to win six consecutive matches and lift the trophy in Qatar.Sunday's final will therefore be only the second Argentina match of Vinčić's international refereeing career.Spain, by contrast, have encountered Vinčić considerably more often, though notably, all of those meetings have come in UEFA competitions, as the Slovenian referee had never officiated Spain in a FIFA World Cup match prior to this 2026 final appointment.Before the final, he had taken charge of four matches involving La Roja, with Spain remaining unbeaten in every one of them.Vinčić's early assignments involving Spain came before the rise of Lamine Yamal at senior international level.His first Spain match came in a 2017 friendly against Colombia, which finished level at 2-2, before he officiated Spain's goalless Euro 2020 group-stage draw against Sweden. He was later appointed for La Roja's UEFA Nations League semi-final clash with Italy in 2023, where Spain secured a 2-1 victory, further highlighting his involvement in major European fixtures.Vinčić has also officiated Spain during the emergence of Lamine Yamal, including two defining matches in their Euro 2024 triumph.These included Spain's 1-0 group-stage victory over Italy and the memorable 2-1 semi-final win over France, where Yamal scored his stunning long-range equaliser before Spain completed another comeback on their way to lifting the European Championship.Across both phases, before and after Yamal's breakthrough, Spain have maintained a perfect record under Vinčić, remaining unbeaten in all four matches.That contrast adds an intriguing subplot to the final, with Spain yet to lose under his whistle, while Argentina's only previous experience with the Slovenian official ended in defeat.Away from football, Vinčić briefly found himself making international headlines in 2020 after he was detained during a police raid on a suspected prostitution and organised crime operation in Bosnia and Herzegovina.Slovenian authorities and Vinčić consistently maintained that he had been attending a business meeting and had no involvement in any criminal activity. He was released without charge, no proceedings were brought against him and he returned to officiating shortly afterwards.His subsequent appointments to the Champions League final, European Championship, World Cup and now the 2026 World Cup final underline the confidence UEFA and FIFA have continued to place in him since that incident.On Sunday, however, none of that history will matter once the whistle blows. Vinčić will oversee only the second World Cup final ever contested between reigning champions Argentina and newly crowned European champions Spain, with football's biggest prize and a place in history awaiting the winner.
Article Summary: Slovenian referee Slavko Vinčić will officiate Sunday's 2026 FIFA World Cup final between Argentina and Spain. The 46-year-old will be assisted by fellow Slovenians Tomaž Klančnik and Andraž Kovačič. Jordan's Adham Makhadmeh has been appointed fourth official and Mohammad Alkalaf reserve assistant referee.

Article Title: Why did Tom Brady reach past Karl-Anthony Towns to slap Logan Paul? The insult that allegedly pushed him too far
Article Text:
Tom Brady reached around Karl-Anthony Towns and slapped Logan Paul during Fanatics Fest in New York on July 17, 2026. (Images via Getty and Twitter)

Logan Paul says a flag football taunt pushed Tom Brady over the line

Tom Brady’s WWE comments make the Fanatics Fest slap harder to take at face value

Tom Brady created Fanatics Fest’s biggest viral moment without throwing a football. The seven-time Super Bowl champion reached around New York Knicks star Karl-Anthony Towns and slapped Logan Paul across the face during an onstage confrontation Friday, July 17, at the Javits Center in New York. Towns immediately stepped between them and held both men apart as they continued talking.The video spread quickly, but the audio does not reveal what caused the confrontation. Paul later provided the only public explanation. He said he had mocked Brady over their March flag football matchup. The footage also left another question hanging over the incident: Did Brady lose his temper, or did the two men just launch a WWE storyline?Paul said the argument began when he brought up his victory over Brady during the Fanatics Flag Football Classic in March. He explained his version of events while reposting the clip on X.“This happened bc I was roasting Tom for beating him in flag football. And he tries to smack me ?? Horrible example for the kids… Aura -100…. + Blocked. With a torn tricep.”Brady did not offer a detailed explanation. He responded to the viral clip with one word: “Dork.”The former New England Patriots and Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback then reposted Paul’s message and added, “I tried America… will try again next time I see this nerd.”Their public feud had already lasted several months. Paul argued during a Fanatics event in February that his WWE career made him as athletic as NFL players. Brady rejected the comparison and mocked Paul before the March flag football tournament.The New York Post reported that Paul referenced his high school football statistics while defending his athletic background. Brady answered with a blunt dismissal.“Logan pulled out of a lot of fights this week. You scored 19 TDs in high school. No one cares,” Brady said.Paul’s Wildcats later defeated Brady’s Founders during the exhibition, although Team USA won the overall event. Brady and Paul continued trading jokes through interviews, videos, and social media posts after the tournament.Paul’s explanation stands supported by the history. He had an obvious result to use against Brady, while Brady had spent months questioning Paul’s football credentials. However, the Fanatics Fest clip contains no clear audio of the argument. Paul’s post remains the only direct account linking the slap to the flag football taunt.Brady’s terrible attempt at maintaining a stoic facade, which pointed to his subpar acting skills, immediately raised questions about whether the confrontation was planned.One day before the slap, Brady joined Cody Rhodes during a live taping of the “What Do You Wanna Talk About?” podcast at Fanatics Fest. Variety reported that Brady openly asked WWE president Nick Khan to find a storyline for him.“I need to get an invite. I’ve been waiting for [WWE president] Nick Khan to come up with some storyline for me to get in the mix,” Brady said.Brady also said retirement had given him an opportunity to consider a different kind of athletic appearance.“I feel like I’m retired from football, and I have an opportunity to go out there and still showcase that I’m a little bit of an athlete. My boy [Rob Gronkowski’s] done it. I’ve seen, obviously, Logan Paul do it. I think I could get in there for at least one match, right?”Those comments changed how many viewers interpreted the slap. Paul is an experienced WWE performer. Towns was already standing directly between the two men. Official Fanatics and WWE accounts also shared the confrontation immediately.Variety reported that Brady, Paul, WWE, and the NFL appeared as collaborators on the Instagram post. The coordinated release made the clip look closer to a promoted wrestling angle than an unexpected fight.Former NFL quarterback Chase Daniel questioned the incident’s authenticity on X.“This has to be so fake…Tom Brady slapping Logan Paul. Right??”No one involved has publicly confirmed that the slap was scripted. Brady and Paul also have not provided evidence that the argument was genuine.Paul’s explanation offers the clearest answer available. He says a flag football taunt caused Brady to react. The surrounding details still deserve scrutiny. Brady had requested a WWE storyline one day earlier, Paul already had a built-in rivalry with him, and the confrontation created an obvious opponent for Brady’s potential wrestling debut.The slap must have hurt, no doubt there. Whether the anger behind it was real remains unanswered.
Article Summary: Tom Brady reached around Karl-Anthony Towns and slapped Logan Paul during Fanatics Fest in New York on July 17, 2026. The video spread quickly, but the audio does not reveal what caused the confrontation. Paul later provided the only public explanation. He said he had mocked Brady over their March flag football matchup. Brady responded to the viral clip with one word: “Dork”

Article Title: Former Rams Super Bowl champion arrested after allegedly setting fire to ex-employer's trucks
Article Text:
Former Rams Super Bowl champion arrested after allegedly setting fire to ex-employer's trucks(Getty)

Former Los Angeles Rams running back faces multiple Arson charges after workplace fire



A former Los Angeles Rams Super Bowl champion is facing serious legal trouble after police accused him of setting fire to vehicles at his former workplace in Florida. Javian Hawkins, who earned a Super Bowl LVI ring with the Rams, now faces multiple felony charges following a fire that damaged company trucks and spread to a nearby building.The case has shocked football fans because Hawkins' NFL journey once looked full of promise. Now, instead of making headlines for football, the former running back finds himself at the center of a criminal investigation.According to the West Melbourne Police Department, officers responded to reports of several vehicles on fire outside Tropic Care of Florida, a landscaping company where Hawkins previously worked. When they arrived, they found three pickup trucks engulfed in flames. Investigators said the fire spread to the exterior of the commercial building before firefighters brought it under control.Police arrested Hawkins after an investigation that included surveillance video, physical evidence, witness interviews, and an accelerant detection K-9. Investigators allege he entered the secured property, took gasoline from an unlocked company vehicle, and then set multiple work trucks on fire.Hawkins now faces charges that include armed burglary, arson of a structure or business, three counts of arson involving a vehicle or structure, and criminal mischief involving more than $1,000 in damage. He remains in custody on a $280,000 bond, while the case moves through the court system.West Melbourne Police Lt. Graig Erenstoft addressed the arrest in a statement shared by the department on Facebook."Arson is an intentional act that puts lives, businesses, and our community at risk. Thanks to the outstanding work of our detectives and our partnership with the Florida State Fire Marshal's Office, we were able to quickly identify and apprehend the individual responsible. We remain committed to ensuring those who commit these dangerous crimes are held fully accountable."The fire also left a major impact on the business. Owner Tony Romano described the damage while speaking with WESH 2 News"The fire just spread up through the garage doors, went in and burned everything in the building. Literally every single thing in the building is completely destroyed."Romano said the alleged incident left him searching for answers. Speaking with WESH 2 News, he said Hawkins appeared to understand the company's decision to let him go. Romano added that the fire did not just damage a building. He said it disrupted the livelihoods of nearly 300 families and subcontractors who depend on the business, making the impact far greater than the property loss alone.Before this arrest, Hawkins built a strong football résumé. He starred at Cocoa High School before setting Louisville's single-season rushing record with 1,525 rushing yards. Although he went undrafted, he spent time with the Atlanta Falcons and Tennessee Titans before joining the Los Angeles Rams practice squad. He earned a Super Bowl LVI championship ring with the Rams and later continued his career in the CFL with the Saskatchewan Roughriders.The allegations against Hawkins remain unproven, and he will have the opportunity to respond to the charges as the legal process continues.
Article Summary: Javian Hawkins, who earned a Super Bowl LVI ring with the Rams, now faces multiple felony charges following a fire that damaged company trucks and spread to a nearby building. Investigators allege he entered the secured property, took gasoline from an unlocked company vehicle, and then set multiple work trucks on fire.

Article Title: Steelers slammed as ‘not a serious organization’ in brutal take that raises fresh questions about Pittsburgh’s direction
Article Text:
Why the Steelers are suddenly being called “not a serious organization” after latest harsh NFL criticism (Getty Images)

Are the Steelers serious Super Bowl contenders in 2026?



Can the Steelers finally break their playoff ceiling?



Pittsburgh has spent nearly two decades avoiding losing seasons like it was written into the franchise charter. Mike Tomlin never finished below .500 in 19 years. That sounds impressive until you realize the Steelers haven't won a playoff game since 2016, got blown out 30-6 by Houston in their only postseason appearance last season, and needed a win over Baltimore in Week 18 just to clinch the AFC North. Nineteen straight non-losing seasons. Zero championships. The Athletic's Vic Tafur put it bluntly: the Steelers are not a serious organization.The Aaron Rodgers situation said a lot about how Pittsburgh operates. Rodgers' return to the Steelers was far from guaranteed. He had been flirting with retirement for multiple offseasons, and when Tomlin stepped down, it seemed even more likely he would walk away for good. Yet Pittsburgh waited, stayed patient, and eventually signed him back. The one-year deal is reportedly worth up to $25 million guaranteed, with another $25 million in incentives.What made the difference? Rodgers himself said it: "I thought that was probably it for me in Pittsburgh. But when the decision was made to hire Mike, I started opening my mind back up to coming back." The McCarthy factor was real. But a franchise building its 2026 hopes around a 42-year-old quarterback playing his farewell season is not exactly a bold vision for the future.Tafur summed it up sharply: "Aaron Rodgers, 42, decided he wanted to come back, and the Steelers aren't a serious organization, so they said sure."That's a harsh read, but not an unfair one. After the 2026 season, McCarthy and General Manager Omar Khan will have to figure out the quarterback position beyond Rodgers. Right now, the depth chart behind him includes Mason Rudolph, Will Howard, and third-round rookie Drew Allar -- neither Howard nor Allar has taken an NFL snap. The succession plan is murky at best.On the field, there are real reasons for optimism. Rodgers is deeply familiar with McCarthy's offensive system after 13 years together in Green Bay. "I spent 13 years in his offense," Rodgers said. "He's changed some stuff when he was in Dallas, but it's stuff that we used to run -- he's just called it something different now." That familiarity could unlock something Pittsburgh's offense has been missing: rhythm, timing, and a quarterback who genuinely trusts his system.The win total is set at 8.5 games. Everything else is about figuring out which side to be on. That number tells you everything about where the league views Pittsburgh right now -- competitive, but not dangerous.In 2025, Rodgers completed 65.7 percent of his passes for 3,322 yards, 24 touchdowns, and just seven interceptions, leading Pittsburgh to a 10-7 record and their first AFC North title since 2020. They needed a win over Baltimore in the final week just to secure it. Then came the playoff loss to Houston — a 30-6 blowout that extended the franchise's winless postseason streak to a full decade.Tafur's projection for 2026 was blunt: "There is enough defensive talent here, and I really like the addition of Michael Pittman Jr., so congratulations to Pittsburgh. Nine wins and they're irrelevant once again."Nine or ten wins used to feel like progress in Pittsburgh. Now it feels like the floor and the ceiling at the same time. McCarthy brings credibility -- he went 125-77 with the Packers and has extensive experience with two of the league's most storied franchises but he also carries a well-earned reputation for underperforming when January arrives.The 2026 Steelers are interesting. They are not yet compelling. If Rodgers stays sharp, the defense holds up, and McCarthy gets his guys playing fast, Pittsburgh could make some noise in the AFC. But the honest baseline for this team is a familiar one: respectable, competitive, and ultimately going home early.
Article Summary: Pittsburgh has spent nearly two decades avoiding losing seasons like it was written into the franchise charter. Mike Tomlin never finished below.500 in 19 years. The Steelers haven't won a playoff game since 2016, got blown out 30-6 by Houston in their only postseason appearance last season.

Article Title: "Privileged to have Mike": Robert Kraft's strong verdict on Mike Vrabel turns heads ahead of New England Patriots camp
Article Text:
Mike Vrabel gets a major vote of confidence ahead of Patriots training camp

Robert Kraft makes Mike Vrabel's position clear ahead of Patriots training camp

Mike Vrabel looks to turn the page after months of scrutiny

Mike Vrabel's difficult offseason is no longer being addressed only by outside voices. As the New England Patriots prepare for training camp, team owner Robert Kraft has publicly backed his head coach for the first time, making it clear that the organization still believes in the man leading the franchise.The statement arrives after months of speculation surrounding Vrabel's future following his highly publicized controversy involving former NFL reporter Dianna Russini. While the headlines shifted attention away from football during the offseason, Kraft's latest comments suggest the Patriots are ready to move forward with their focus firmly on the upcoming season.Speaking during an appearance alongside Fanatics CEO Michael Rubin, Kraft was asked about Vrabel's eventful offseason and how the organization handled the situation. Rather than avoiding the topic, the Patriots owner delivered a clear message of support for his head coach."Well, we’re privileged to have Mike as our head coach," Kraft replied. "You know, no one is infallible. And what’s great about Mike is he has great intellectual knowledge about football, all the technical skills. He relates to the players beautifully."Kraft continued by reinforcing his long-term faith in Vrabel."And he’s someone I have a strong belief and faith in. And I hope he’s going to be our head coach for many years to come."The comments mark Kraft's first public response since the controversy became one of the NFL's biggest offseason stories. Instead of discussing the past in detail, he focused on Vrabel's leadership, football knowledge and relationship with players, signaling that the franchise remains fully committed to its head coach.The timing is also significant, with veterans set to report for training camp soon and the Patriots hoping to keep attention on football rather than offseason distractions.The controversy first surfaced in April after photos of Vrabel and longtime NFL insider Dianna Russini sparked widespread discussion. In the weeks that followed, Vrabel stepped away from part of the NFL Draft to begin counseling and later acknowledged that he had held difficult conversations with his family, team officials, coaches and players.Russini also addressed the impact the situation had on her life, saying, "This has had a significant impact on my life, both professionally and personally," while describing herself as a former journalist.Despite the public attention, the Patriots never indicated that Vrabel's position was in danger. Kraft's latest remarks now remove any remaining doubt about where the organization stands.The confidence comes after an impressive first season under Vrabel, as New England returned to the Super Bowl and entered the offseason with expectations of remaining among the AFC's top contenders. The front office also strengthened the roster by acquiring wide receiver A.J. Brown, adding another major weapon ahead of the new campaign.With training camp about to begin, the Patriots appear eager to leave the offseason behind. Kraft's public endorsement sends a strong message that the franchise believes its future is still best served with Mike Vrabel leading the team from the sidelines.
Article Summary: New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft has publicly backed Mike Vrabel for the first time. Kraft made the comments during an appearance with Fanatics CEO Michael Rubin. The statement comes after months of speculation surrounding V rabel's future. The Patriots returned to the Super Bowl and entered the offseason with expectations of remaining among the AFC's top contenders.

Tony Farmer post(Image via X)

Matt Miller's name has stayed in the headlines for more than one reason this month. Fresh scrutiny over allegations tied to fantasy football leagues has now sparked another wave of discussion after old social media posts aimed at Brittany Mahomes resurfaced online.The renewed attention began after San Francisco 49ers insider Tony Farmer shared screenshots of the years-old posts on X. The messages spread quickly across social media, with many fans questioning Miller's past online behavior while he already faced criticism over the separate fantasy football controversy.Tony Farmer highlighted posts Miller wrote in September 2020 after the NFL released its annual Top 100 Players rankings. Patrick Mahomes came in at No. 4 despite leading the Kansas City Chiefs to a Super Bowl title during the 2019 season.Brittany Mahomes reacted on X, formerly Twitter, defending her husband after the rankings sparked debate among fans. Miller replied with a remark that many users considered inappropriate."To those questioning the reason: She would know."He then followed it with another post that read:"Also f*ck off."Farmer also shared several other old posts in which Miller used profanity during exchanges on social media. Those screenshots quickly drew attention and added another layer to the criticism surrounding the ESPN draft analyst.The resurfaced posts come as Miller already faces questions over allegations involving fantasy football leagues. According to “The Athletic” dozens of participants accused him of failing to pay league winnings over several years. The report also said some charities may not have received promised donations connected to those leagues. Miller has denied intentionally misleading participants, but the allegations continue to receive attention.The controversy has unfolded alongside a major personal setback. On June 17, 2026, Miller suffered serious injuries in a head-on crash on Missouri Route 96 in Jasper County after his vehicle crossed the centerline and collided with a semi-truck. He later revealed that doctors performed a life-saving amputation of his left arm.Following the accident, Miller announced that he would step away from ESPN indefinitely to focus on his recovery. His leave came as the fantasy football allegations continued to make headlines.The resurfaced posts have sparked mixed reactions across social media. Some users argued that comments made years ago should be viewed in the context of when they were written. Others said the language reflected poorly on someone who represents a major sports network. While the debate continues online, the screenshots have kept Miller's past social media activity in the spotlight alongside the ongoing fantasy football allegations.Now, the old Brittany Mahomes posts have resurfaced at a time when Miller remains under intense public scrutiny. Although the comments are nearly six years old, their return has reignited debate over professionalism, online conduct and how past social media posts can continue to shape public perception years later.

Now, old social media posts aimed at Kansas City Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes have resurfaced online. The resurfaced posts have reignited debate over professionalism and online conduct.

Article Title: NFL Trade Rumors: Saints urged to land $36 million offensive weapon to accelerate Tyler Shough's development this season
Article Text:
New Orleans Saints trade rumors (Getty Images)

Why are the Saints being linked with a trade for Josh Palmer?

Does New Orleans really need another veteran receiver?

The New Orleans Saints have made it clear that the franchise is building around rookie quarterback Tyler Shough, but giving a young passer every chance to succeed often means strengthening the talent around him. That is why fresh trade speculation has linked New Orleans with Buffalo Bills wide receiver Josh Palmer ahead of the 2026 NFL season. While there is no sign that Buffalo is actively shopping the veteran, one analyst believes Palmer's familiarity with Saints head coach Kellen Moore could make him a logical target if New Orleans decides it needs another proven option alongside Chris Olave.The latest idea came from Bleacher Report's Moe Moton, who suggested one trade every NFL team should explore before the regular season. For New Orleans, his proposal involved sending a late-round 2027 draft pick to Buffalo in exchange for Palmer, who signed a three-year, $36 million contract with the Bills before the 2025 campaign.The suggestion is rooted less in Palmer's production in Buffalo and more in his history with Moore. During their time together with the Los Angeles Chargers, Moore coordinated an offense in which Palmer delivered one of the better seasons of his career.That existing familiarity could reduce the adjustment period if the receiver were to join New Orleans.Moton explained the reasoning behind the proposal."If the Bills plan to keep wideout Keon Coleman and allow him a chance to bounce back from a regression season, Palmer could be on the way out of Buffalo after one term. The 26-year-old had an uneventful 2025 campaign, hauling in 22 passes for 303 scoreless yards," Moton wrote.He added, "The Saints can reunite Palmer with head coach Kellen Moore, who called plays for the Los Angeles Chargers offense when the wideout caught 38 passes for 581 yards and two touchdowns in 2023. New Orleans can bring him in as veteran insurance if there are concerns about rookie first-rounder Jordyn Tyson's durability."Palmer finished his first season with Buffalo with 22 receptions for 303 yards and did not score a touchdown, making it a disappointing year by his standards.The bigger question is whether such a move is realistic. At this stage, there is little evidence suggesting Buffalo intends to part with Palmer. The Bills had an opportunity to move on before his salary for the upcoming season became fully guaranteed in March but chose to keep him, a decision that points to continued confidence in his role.Even so, the discussion highlights a genuine need within the Saints' offense. Chris Olave remains the clear No. 1 target after topping 1,000 receiving yards in three of his four NFL seasons. Beyond him, however, the depth chart carries uncertainty.First-round pick Jordyn Tyson arrives with significant expectations after being selected eighth overall in the 2026 NFL Draft. His talent is undeniable, but asking a rookie to shoulder a major workload immediately can be risky. Adding an experienced receiver would give Shough another dependable target while easing pressure on Tyson's transition to the professional game.Whether Palmer ultimately becomes available is another matter. But as New Orleans looks to accelerate its young quarterback's development, exploring experienced receiving help before Week 1 would be a sensible approach.
Article Summary: New Orleans Saints linked with Buffalo Bills wide receiver Josh Palmer. Analyst believes Palmer's familiarity with Saints head coach Kellen Moore could make him a logical target. No sign that Buffalo is actively shopping the veteran. New Orleans could bring Palmer in as veteran insurance for rookie first-rounder Jordyn Tyson.

Indianapolis CB Kenny Moore II linked to Carolina Panthers

Kenny Moore II tied to Washington Commanders

Kansas City Chiefs could benefit from 30 YO Colts cornerback

Free agent cornerback Kenny Moore II’s top priority is winning

Kenny Moore II free agency rumors

He is a pure nickel corner with high-level defender skill.He would be ideal for Chiefs defensive coordinator Steve Spagnuolo’s aggressive, attacking scheme.The veteran cornerback Kenny Moore II told SiriusXM NFL Radio that he has reached a stage in his career where winning is his topmost priority.He wants to join a team that has the right culture and defensive scheme. He wants to contribute there as a leader, not just fill a vacant roster spot.Moore is open to playing any role that the team would like to offer. He is not seeking individual recognition.He wants to give more to the local community, too, just as he did in Indianapolis.Moore wants to be a team player first and help his team reach new heights on the gridiron, winning championships.“I’m at the perfect point in my career where I really want to win,” Moore told SiriusXM NFL Radio.“And hopefully that comes with a team that has the culture, the scheme set up for me.I just don’t want to be a guy on the team because I feel like I have so many strengths to give to the team and be a leader.But for me, I was probably putting down in my notes two days ago, when I was flying in.It’s more so, whatever role I have on a team, it’s more like perfecting that role and not really…it’s less about me. I don’t talk about me.I want to talk about how I can be in a new place and serve. I want to serve not just the team or just learn the plays;I want to serve the community and continue everything I was doing in Indy.Where I was in Indy, it was less me and more about the team. So, I want to be a team guy, and I want to win, and hopefully we can do that together.”
Article Summary: The 30-year-old cornerback Kenny Moore II is looking for a new home after being released by the Indianapolis Colts this offseason. Carolina Panthers, Washington Commanders, and Kansas City Chiefs could eye $57M veteran cornerback. Moore wants to join a team that has the right culture and scheme.

Article Title: Patrick Mahomes is worth seven first round draft picks if Kansas City Chiefs ever decide to trade their star quarterback
Article Text:
Patrick Mahomes is worth seven first round draft picks if Kansas City Chiefs ever decide to trade their star quarterback (Image via Getty: Patrick Mahomes​)

Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes’ trade value is seven picks

Josh Allen defeated Patrick Mahomes in Top NFL Quarterbacks for 2026

ACL injury is scary. It could break a quarterback’s career. Or just get him traded to another franchise.No wonder ESPN’s Bill Barnwell suggested seven first-round draft picks for Patrick Mahomes In the article titled, “2026 NFL Trade Tiers: Players Worth Round 1 Picks By Team,” ESPN’s Bill Barnwell picked Patrick Mahomes for the Kansas City Chiefs. Trevor Lawrence for the Jacksonville Jaguars is worth two first-round draft picks. Cam Ward for the Tennessee Titans is also worth two first-round draft picks.Joe Burrow for the Cincinnati Bengals is worth four first-round draft picks. And Lamar Jackson for the Baltimore Ravens is worth two first-round draft picks and more.It was Patrick Mahomes who scored the highest, with seven first-round draft picks.It could have been more if there had been no ACL tear in December 2025?Or was it because of the ACL that the Kansas City Chiefs’ ace quarterback is ever even mentioned on the list of trade options?Who can stop a player from getting injured? Quarterbacks run and get attacked on the gridiron. They are bound to get injured. But to name it? Wow.ESPN’s Bill Barnwell is of the opinion: would a torn ACL stop anyone from trading the farm to land Mahomes?The analyst believes that Josh Allen is the best quarterback in football at the moment.He outplayed Mahomes consecutively in the past three seasons.But it’s the postseason halo and consistent success before 2025 [read: ACL injury] that could charm several NFL teams into wanting or trading for Patrick.The three-time Super Bowl champion will turn 31 this November.If the Chiefs decide to trade him, there could be some hesitation about committing too many future picks, given his age and brutal knee injury.But then Bill Barnwell’s “seven picks” suggestion could make sense because of Patrick’s decade of high-level quarterback play and his status as the best player of his generation.According to several NFL executives, coaches, scouts, and others,Buffalo Bills QB Josh Allen ranks No. 1 and Kansas City Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes ranks No. 2 in the Top NFL Quarterbacks for 2026, ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reported.Last year’s ranking was reversed. Allen took second spot while Mahomes reigned first.Both of them are 30. But something happened in 2025 that brought Mahomes down.Allen broke Mahomes’ three-year-long consecutive first rank standing. How is that?According to an NFL general manager,“He’s the most singularly unstoppable player at the position when you get his A-game, and he has cut down on the turnovers the past two seasons.”In the 2023 season, Allen had 22 turnovers. In 2024, he had 8 turnovers. And in 2025, he had 13 turnovers.As for Mahomes...Why is he in the No. 2 spot?Over the three seasons before 2025, he had subpar production [by his standards], ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reported.And according to an NFL personnel director, Kansas City’s “weak supporting cast” has camouflaged Mahomes’s greatness.The Chiefs have struggled to run effectively in recent years.And the wide receiver trio Xavier Worthy, Rashee Rice, and Hollywood Brown could never become a consistent threat on the gridiron.One example is the play when Mahomes got his ACL torn. Three Los Angeles Chargers defenders were charging at him.He had to run out of his normal protected zone behind the offensive line to throw the ball.He knew the throw would be futile, but he still stretched his body and threw a pass that wasn’t going to save the game.During the intense effort, he was tackled and tore his ACL in his left knee.Mahomes had gone 125 games without losing three in a row, but that fateful December day, he did.
Article Summary: Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes’ trade value is seven picks. ESPN’s Bill Barnwell suggested seven first-round draft picks for Mahomes. Josh Allen defeated Mahomes in Top NFL Quarterbacks for 2026. Mahomes had gone 125 games without losing three games in a row, but he did tear his left knee.

Article Title: Drafting Lamar Jackson shattered Joe Flacco’s vision of a Baltimore Ravens dynasty
Article Text:
Drafting Lamar Jackson shattered Joe Flacco's vision of a Baltimore Ravens dynasty (Image via Getty: Lamar Jackson and Joe Flacco​)

Lamar Jackson’s entry broke Joe Flacco’s dream of playing 20 years with Baltimore Ravens and winning Super Bowls

Joe Flacco shone for the Cincinnati Bengals

This calls for a comparison! Doesn’t it? What did Joe Flacco do for the Baltimore Ravens, and what is Lamar Jackson doing for the franchise?Well, for starters, four years after playing for the Ravens, Flacco gave them their first Super Bowl in 12 years!It was the second one ever. First, having been in 2001.As for Jackson? He joined Baltimore in 2018. It’s been over 8 seasons, but there’s been no Super Bowl appearance! Not even once.The franchise looked for a new face in Jackson after Flacco. But Jackson somehow is not turning out to be what they’d expected.Flacco, on the other hand, shared in the Netflix’s Quarterback series that he had a dream of playing 20 years for the Ravens and winning several Super Bowls for them.Had they stayed with him? Would they have had a chance? Maybe.Ever since Joe Flacco left the franchise, he has been playing every year with a different franchise. Maybe he left his heart in Baltimore.This is sure to have affected him. The separation that came with breaking up with his Super Bowl-winning franchise.He spent 11 seasons [2008-2018] with Baltimore. He played 2019 for the Denver Broncos, 2020 for the New York Jets,2021 for the Philadelphia Eagles, 2021-22 for the New York Jets again, 2023 for the Cleveland Browns, 2024 for the Indianapolis Colts,2025 for the Cleveland Browns and Cincinnati Bengals.And now, 2026 for the Cincinnati Bengals again.Every year, he hopes to play even at the age of 40! He has five kids – four boys and one girl. They all look up to their NFL Dad.They stare at his Super Bowl MVP trophy and ring with immense pride in their eyes. But there’s still some part of them that truly doesn’t believe in him.One of his sons benched Flacco [probably in Fantasy Football for kids] during a Cleveland Browns game when Flacco was to face his parent franchise, the Baltimore Ravens.They lost that game. He questioned his stakes.The next moment, they received a call from Cleveland GM Andrew Berry, who told Flacco he had been traded to Cincinnati.His wife, Dana Grady, was more than happy. All she wanted was for some NFL team to want him. And they did!The Bengals, who had a wounded soldier, Joe Burrow , needed help in the quarterback room. That’s where Flacco came in.Midseason last year, he was traded from Cleveland to Cincinnati. His kids thought it was a joke. But no, it wasn’t.They packed their bags, and Bengals head coach Zac Taylor was waiting for them at the other end.Playing for the Bengals, he recorded a 61.7 completion percentage for 1,664 passing yards and 13 touchdowns, and just 4 interceptions.He secured a 91.0 passer rating at the age of 40.X users made fun of Cincinnati Bengals 40-year-old QB Joe Flacco and Pittsburgh Steelers 41-year-old QB Aaron Rodgers when they faced off, saying, “Battle of the uncs on TNF.”But did it stop Flacco from playing? No, it did not! His willpower to play, irrespective of his age, is stronger than any comeback story.Even if Lamar Jackson broke his dream of playing for Baltimore,something that happened with Rob Gronkowski, where he joined the New England Patriots just for a day, to retire as a Patriot,could happen with Flacco, where he would join the Baltimore Ravens for a day, just to retire as a Raven…
Article Summary: Joe Flacco played for the Baltimore Ravens for 11 seasons, winning two Super Bowls. He was traded to the Cincinnati Bengals for a wounded soldier, Joe Burrow. Flacco has been playing every year since then, even at the age of 40. He has five kids – four boys and one girl.

Article Title: Mike Tomlin could pull off a stunning return as a Steelers rival emerges as a surprising landing spot
Article Text:
Mike Tomlin could pull off a stunning return as a Steelers rival emerges as a surprising landing spot(Getty)

Bengals emerge as the most surprising team linked to Mike Tomlin



Mike Tomlin has not coached an NFL game since stepping down as Pittsburgh Steelers head coach. He quickly moved into broadcasting with NBC, but talk about a return to the sidelines has never really disappeared. Now, one AFC North team has entered that conversation in a way few expected.The idea remains speculative, but it has picked up attention after recent comments from former NFL coach Jon Gruden and a report linking Tomlin to several possible coaching openings. One destination stands out because it would put the longtime Steelers coach on the opposite sideline against his former team twice every season.The biggest twist came from Steelers Wire writer Allison Koehler, who recently listed four teams that could make sense if Mike Tomlin decides to coach again. Along with the New York Jets, Indianapolis Colts and Tampa Bay Buccaneers, Koehler included the Cincinnati Bengals, a move that immediately grabbed attention because of the AFC North rivalry.Koehler wrote that Bengals coach Zac Taylor still has support after leading Cincinnati to a Super Bowl appearance and multiple playoff runs. However, she also pointed out that the Bengals have missed the playoffs in three straight seasons.If that streak reaches four, Taylor's future could come under serious pressure despite the organization's faith in him.The Bengals finished 6-11 in the 2025 season after injuries forced them to rely on Jake Browning and Joe Flacco when Joe Burrow went down. Team owner Mike Brown kept Taylor and executive Duke Tobin in place after the season, but another disappointing year with a healthy Burrow could change the conversation.Meanwhile, former NFL coach Jon Gruden added more fuel to the discussion during an appearance on "Not Just Football with Cam Heyward." While speaking with Steelers defensive tackle Cam Heyward, Gruden compared a potential Tomlin move to the Denver Broncos trading a first-round pick for Sean Payton in 2023. "If you get a guy like Mike Tomlin, he's going to hire a good group of coaches, and he's going to develop players, that's worth a lot more than a first-round pick, if you ask me," Gruden said on Not Just Football with Cam HeywardThere is another hurdle. The Steelers still control Tomlin's coaching rights through the 2027 season. Any franchise that wants to hire him before then would likely need Pittsburgh's approval and could have to offer draft compensation.For now, Tomlin remains part of NBC's Football Night in America team for the 2026 season. Still, if Cincinnati struggles again, one of the NFL's fiercest rivalries could take an unexpected turn. The Bengals would not just chase an accomplished coach. They would try to bring one of the Steelers' most successful figures into their own locker room.
Article Summary: Mike Tomlin has not coached an NFL game since stepping down as Pittsburgh Steelers head coach. He quickly moved into broadcasting with NBC, but talk about a return to the sidelines has never really disappeared. A Steelers Wire writer recently listed four teams that could make sense if Tomlin decides to coach again.

Article Title: James Harden sends open message to LeBron James amid Cleveland Cavaliers rumors
Article Text:
James Harden and LeBron James. Image via: Mark J. Terrill/ AP

James Harden wants to play alongside LeBron James in the Cleveland Cavaliers

Why is LeBron James' Cleveland Cavaliers rumor gaining traction?

What happens next in LeBron James' free agency

James Harden made his pitch for LeBron James to join the Cleveland Cavaliers, telling reporters at Fanatics Fest on Friday that he hopes the four-time champion picks Cleveland in free agency. The comments add another voice to a growing list of players and executives publicly courting James , whose decision remains unresolved more than two weeks into his free agency search.The timing matters because Harden himself is a free agent after declining his player option, and his own next contract may be tied to how much financial flexibility Cleveland needs to make a run at James.Speaking at the fan convention, Harden didn't hold back on what he'd like to see happen. "I hope he comes to Cleveland," Harden said, framing it as a fitting way for James to close out his career close to home. He added that he doesn't expect any single pitch to sway James one way or another, saying the decision ultimately belongs to James alone, but that whichever team lands him will instantly get better.Harden's interest goes beyond nostalgia. According to Joe Vardon of The Athletic, Harden is reportedly holding off on signing his own new deal with Cleveland specifically to preserve cap space that could help the Cavs pursue James. That's a notable show of patience from a player who could otherwise lock in his next contract immediately.James has deep roots in Cleveland. The Akron, Ohio native was the No. 1 overall pick in the 2003 draft and delivered the franchise's only championship in 2016 during his second stint with the team.He later signed with the Los Angeles Lakers, and after eight seasons there, he's now weighing his next move as a 24th NBA season approaches.The Cavaliers already have pieces in place that make the fit appealing. Harden, Donovan Mitchell, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen give James an established core coming off a trip to the conference finals, even after the sweep at the hands of the Knicks. Cleveland also plays in the Eastern Conference, generally viewed as an easier path than the West.James has been linked to other teams as well. He has golfed with Golden State's Draymond Green, referenced the Philadelphia 76ers' old "trust the process" mantra during Fanatics Fest, and stayed in contact through agent Rich Paul with Miami president Pat Riley. None of those signals carry the same weight as his history with Cleveland, but they show James is genuinely exploring multiple options rather than treating this as a formality.Whether James and Harden could mesh on the court remains an open question, since both are ball dominant playmakers who typically need the rock in their hands to be most effective. For now, Harden has made his preference clear. What James ultimately decides is still anyone's guess.
Article Summary: James Harden wants LeBron James to join the Cleveland Cavaliers in free agency. The Houston Rockets star made the comments at Fanatics Fest on Friday. Harden is a free agent after declining his player option. James has been linked to other teams as well.

Article Title: Caitlin Clark scripts history with new career high record against Seattle Storm
Article Text:

Caitlin Clark scored career high against Seattle Storm

Player MIN PTS FG 3PT FT REB AST STL BLK TO PF Caitlin Clark 29 45 11-18 6-10 17-19 2 10 4 2 4 4

Caitlin Clark makes WNBA history as fastest to 200 career 3-pointers

Caitlin Clark set a new career high with 45 points as the Indiana Fever held off the Seattle Storm 110-107 on Friday night, becoming the first player in WNBA history to record a 40-point, 10-assist game in the same outing. The performance came just days after Clark had been mired in a shooting slump, and it arrived alongside another milestone, as she also became the fastest player in league history to reach 200 career three-pointers.Clark's night mattered beyond the box score. It gave the Fever a signature win and gave Clark herself a clear signal that the slump was behind her heading into a tough back-to-back against the New York Liberty.Clark finished 11 of 18 from the field and knocked down 6 of 10 attempts from beyond the arc, a sharp turnaround after going just 3 of 19 from three over her previous three games. She also got to the free throw line 19 times, converting 17, an aggressive approach that came one game after she voiced frustration with officiating during a loss to the Golden State Valkyries.The 45 points stand as the most in a single game in Fever franchise history, and Clark's 10 assists made her the first player in WNBA history to post a 40-point, 10-assist stat line.Her long step back three with 39.1 seconds remaining broke a tie and gave Indiana the lead for good, coming right after she blocked a shot from Seattle rookie Flau'jae Johnson to set up the possession.Caitlin Clark reached the 200 career three-pointer mark in the second quarter, hitting a 26-footer off an assist from Tyasha Harris with 7:29 left in the half. She got there in just 74 games, breaking the previous record of 81 games set by Katie Smith with Minnesota between 1999 and 2001. Smith sits third on the WNBA's all-time three-point list with 906, behind Diana Taurasi's 1,447 and Sue Bird's 1,001.Clark's scoring output also tied her with A'Ja Wilson for the second-most points in a single game this WNBA season, trailing only Marina Mabrey's 53-point outing last month.Kelsey Mitchell provided support with 30 points of her own, giving Indiana's All-Star backcourt a rare game where both players clicked at the same time after frequently carrying the offense individually this season. Defense remains a concern for the Fever, who played without Aliyah Boston as she managed a right lower leg injury, and Seattle's young frontcourt duo of Dominique Malonga and Awa Fam took advantage, combining for 44 points and 23 rebounds. Boston is expected back and coach Stephanie White said Clark is also set to play Saturday when the Fever face the Liberty at 7 p.m. CST on CBS.
Article Summary: Caitlin Clark scored 45 points as the Indiana Fever beat the Seattle Storm 110-107. She became the first player in WNBA history to record a 40-point, 10-assist game in the same outing. Clark also became the fastest player in league history to reach 200 career three-pointers.

Article Title: NBA free agency rumor: Miami Heat boss drops cryptic hint about landing LeBron James to pair with Giannis Antetokounmpo

Which teams are interested in LeBron James?

What is Pat Riley saying about the trade rumor?

Contract details and salary cap implications

How the trade could impact Miami Heat

Miami Heat president Pat Riley hinted at pursuing LeBron James after acquiring Giannis Antetokounmpo from Milwaukee, referencing "landing the plane" on both deals. James, 41, is an unrestricted free agent considering Miami, Golden State, Philadelphia, Cleveland, Minnesota and Denver for 2026-27. Riley called the pursuit "organic" and declined to guarantee a signing, per Thursday's introductory press conference.Riley never said the name. He didn't have to.Six teams are reportedly in the mix for James after he announced he won't return to the Los Angeles Lakers for 2026-27: the Heat, Warriors, 76ers, Cavaliers, Timberwolves and Nuggets.James has not named a favorite. He teased a decision was coming during a CNBC Boardroom panel Thursday, saying, "I won't hold you guys up too much longer," but held off announcing anything at his own podcast taping earlier that day.As per Pat Riley’s recent cryptic comment during Giannis Antetokounmpo’s official debut to the Miami Heat, the organization is making moves to land the former Lakers Star. It will mark James’ return to the franchise after 12 years.Riley described the moment Heat basketball operations chief Andy Elisburg called to confirm the Antetokounmpo trade was done. In full, Riley said: "I got a call about the trade after a month of discussion.And the call came late, and he said to me, 'We have a deal.' He closed the deal, and we both sort of screamed out loud. Yeah, we landed the plane."He then added, "There's another one we have to land," a clear nod to James.Asked directly where the Heat stand with James, Riley pumped the brakes but didn't close the door. In full: "I don't know. I really don't. To be transparent about it, we've had discussions over a week ago, maybe a week before that about it, but right now, I think we're like everybody else. We're just waiting to see what he does, and then we'll see what happens. I really can't answer that right now."No contract framework for James has been reported. His camp has kept terms private while he weighs six suitors. The Heat's flexibility depends partly on how the Antetokounmpo trade reshaped their books, though full cap numbers from that deal have not been disclosed publicly.Riley was clear that Antetokounmpo alone changes Miami's outlook. In full: "That definitely helps when you have a top-five player in the world. As far as the 24-year veteran, that is something that would happen organically." He added he's confident in the current roster regardless of James: "This is a team that we have right now, and I'm happy with it. And I think this is Spo's challenge."The next marker is James himself. He's signaled a decision is close, and Riley's Heat are one of six teams waiting to see which way he leans.
Article Summary: Miami Heat president Pat Riley hinted at pursuing LeBron James after acquiring Giannis Antetokounmpo from Milwaukee. Riley called the pursuit "organic" and declined to guarantee a signing. James, 41, is an unrestricted free agent considering Miami, Golden State, Philadelphia, Cleveland, Minnesota and Denver.
